title: Juniper
summary: One welcoming identity, from the morning coffee to the last aperitivo.
cardAlt: Juniper takeaway cup and café setting
tagline: Bright mornings. Long evenings. One easy rhythm.
introduction: A café and aperitivo bar designed to move naturally through the day, with an identity that feels just as right at eight in the morning as eight at night.

heroArtwork.alt: Forest green engraved juniper branches and berries.

heroImage.alt: Juniper forest green coffee cup and menu beside coffee and an orange aperitivo.

challenge.heading: Two moods. One place people remember.
challenge.copy: The concept moved from coffee and pastries into aperitivo and small plates, but the early identity made those moments feel like separate businesses. Juniper needed a name and voice broad enough to hold the whole day together.

contribution.heading: A flexible identity with a botanical spark.
contribution.copy: We created the Juniper name, a characterful wordmark, and a botanical system that shifts in energy across cups, menus, packaging, and evening communications while remaining unmistakably part of the same place.

outcome.heading: One identity that keeps pace with the day.
outcome.copy: Juniper now feels coherent from the first takeaway cup to the last round at the bar, giving the team a flexible brand that can change mood without losing its character.
